project_summary: An agent for the Pokemon TCG Kaggle competition (submissions closed 2026-08-16; the Strategy write-up is due 2026-09-13 23:59 UTC). Seven weeks of multi-agent research on how to make a card-game policy measurably stronger, most of it spent discovering how our own instruments lied. The inventory is the asset: the record of what was tried, why, how, what happened, and what it taught.
current_state: Jon 2026-09-05: 'we are not continuing experiments until we know we can reliably learn from the ones we have done.' Games = 0 by directive. Live work is the inventory itself and the Strategy write-up derived from it. The last experiment (ASTRA, 2026-09-05) was a 40-game empty-bench screen with zero intervention reach, parked by its pre-registered rule.

methods.name: Standard error of a win-rate gap
methods.definition: For independent Bernoulli arms at p=0.5 and N games per arm, SE(gap)=100*sqrt(0.5/N) pp. Total T=2N gives 100/sqrt(T). This is distinct from the historical empirical sigma law, whose primary provenance remains unresolved.

methods.name: Minimum detectable effect at 80% power
methods.definition: Historical table: 2.8 * sigma_delta gives 9.88pp at n=400, 7.06pp at n=1200 and 4.55pp at n=2400 per arm. Arithmetic reproduces; primary calibration provenance remains unresolved. The separate scaling law gives different values. These historical numbers are not a validated power design for a new experiment.
methods.status: arithmetic reviewed; calibration unresolved; no current allocation

methods.name: Wilson score interval
methods.definition: 95% interval for a binomial proportion, z = 1.959963985

methods.name: Kill-only screen rule
methods.definition: Historical n=400 kill-only policy is not a universal inference rule. CI [-1,+1]pp has a negative lower bound but does not establish harm. Operational stopping and scientific refutation differ. Admission size needs a declared design and effect; n>=1200 alone does not guarantee adequate power.

methods.name: Ladder rating scale
methods.definition: mu per +1pp win-rate: 5.45 (b = 217.55, conservative, use for approval); 6.66 sensitivity; 9.20 excluded. c = sqrt(2 beta^2 + sigma_1^2 + sigma_2^2) = 217.55 at the sigma floor 35

methods.name: Promotion rule (three-leg foreign-policy panel)
methods.definition: >=60% head-to-head at n>=400 on a lineage-diverse panel, no CI-separated loss, at least one CI-separated win; later amended: leg 1 Confirm-SPRT, legs 2-3 n>=1200 or a null control

methods.name: Between-batch variance
methods.definition: tau = 1.18pp between batches of the same arm; a screen winner regresses toward it

methods.name: Retraction check before citation
methods.definition: every printed decimal or hash is looked up in the register's values table; a hit is RETRACTED, a miss is NOT a certificate

methods.name: Explicit state of an artifact
methods.definition: a top-level status/verdict/state key in JSON, or a Verdict:/Status: line in a markdown head; fenced blocks and blockquotes are not declarations; two different declarations are a conflict (no state)

methods.name: Claim binding is nomination, not adjudication
methods.definition: a number that matches an answer-map node is NAMED_BY(node:status), never SUPPORTED; only the register yields a verdict (RETRACTED)
